title: Time taken
goal: Every plan shows how long the work took (skill invoked to plan closed), and hovering the total shows the breakdown: lead planning, lanes running, lead between lanes, lead verifying, worker time per phase and per lane.

waves.name: Wave 1 · Time taken
waves.note: Contract: checks/time.check.mjs (fake lanes, exact minutes per segment and phase). One lane: backend shape and both pages share CAUI.timeCard.

lanes.why: laneTime + plan time in ca.mjs, startedAt/closedAt stamps, CAUI.fmtDur/timeCard, hover cards in Lanes and Office

next: Read the summary, run every check on main
Lead eye review: hover card in Lanes and Office at desktop and phone, live plan ticking
Sync the skill, tell the lead to write startedAt in SKILL.md

Generic extra providers in the runner: user-local providers file outside the repo (openai-compatible, key by env var name), RATE_FALLBACK_MODEL knob unset by default; no provider, model or key of this machine in shipped code

decisions.text: Plan start = startedAt the lead writes (skill invocation), else earliest decision or lane start; end = closedAt from ca plan close, else now (live). Lane time counts run windows only, so paused gaps are lead time, not lane time.
Fixed a timing flake in checks/lanes.check.mjs (doctor rows can take seconds): poll for them instead of a fixed 1.8 s wait.

User added a paid model DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017: key stored as DEEPSEEK_API_KEY (user env), probe lane on deepseek/deepseek-flash DONE in 17 s through a patched runner copy. Policy: MaaS by default, paid model only for rate limits or extra parallel lanes. Runner wiring (deepseek provider, rate-limit fallback, doctor row) waits until the timetaken lane merges, since both touch runner/ca.mjs.
Overrule my own plan: the paid model stays a local preference. The runner gets a generic, opt-in extra-provider mechanism instead of a hardcoded deepseek provider.

risks: Hover card re-rendered by the 2 s poll could flicker or close while open.
Top bar overflow on phones with one more chip in Office.
